lines.en: : Hah...
: This is hard...
: Every time I try to write anything, all that comes out is a straight line or an arrow...
: Maybe I should just give up for now...
: There’s no way I can compete with someone like Otoha anyway...
: I guess Sensei is kind of a creep, though...so maybe I do have a chance after all?...
: And...I know him better than she does, so...maybe there’s some way for me to take advantage of that?...
: Ugh...
: But me winning would mean all ten of us would have to stay at his house...
: And if my confession is too good, he might think I...
: Who am I kidding?...
: I’m the same as everyone else.
: But it’s not like I can just say that...can I?...
: Would being honest even make for a good confession?...
: Or should I maybe...play to my strengths instead?...
: I could, like...tug on his sleeve?...
: And take him...somewhere private...
: Pause a little...longer than normal...when I’m talking to him...
: He likes that...right?...
: He likes...that side of me...
: And...staying that way would be...the easiest thing for...mnh...all of us...
: Hah......ah.......not again.....
: Maybe...if we’re in private...he’ll...haah...
: Maybe...ahh...where...no one can see us...I can...make him realize...just how much I...
: How much I’m...just like...everyone else...
: But you’re not.
: Aah! Hah! Wha! Huh?! How...
: How...how much of that did you hear?! And...and why are you here?! I’m...I’m supposed to...be alone...
: Why is it you think you’re the same as everyone else?
: That is...the actual...last thing I want to talk to you about...
: If there is something that pains you, I can not make it go away. But with His guidance, I may be able to guide you as well.
: Um...with all...due respect, Yasu...I don’t think you’ll be...much help when...it comes to writing...a confession...
: I confess every single day. To every unwanted urge and every unwelcome thought. It is you who knows next to nothing about the act of confessing.
: Is that why you see yourself the same as the others? Is it because none of you understand?
: That is...definitely not what...
: Then what is it?

: As His child, I am prepared to accept your truth- even if that truth is hard to swallow. For I know that it is but a single bump on a single road. And there are much greater things to fear than what ails you.
: All I meant was...we’re all...chasing after...the same thing...
: And I...want what...everyone else has...
: Then that is your confession.
: No, it...I think it has to be longer than that...
: It’s for...It’s for the competition...
: Oh!
: I believe I may have misunderstood you. I was under the impression you were in need of shepherding as well.
: I didn’t realize this confession was for the teacher.
: Hahah...hah...yeah...that’s...
: I feel like that’s...what most people would assume when...talking about...making a confession...
: Then it makes sense that I didn’t understand — for I am no person at all.
: Would you like to know what I am, Sana?
: Um...uhh...
: I’m special.
: But...wouldn’t that...make you...still a person?...
: I’m not sure.
: If I am a person, why is it that I am able to see things no one else does?
: Why am I able to pick words out of the wind and hold God inside of my heart?
: I think...being a person just...means...you’re a human...
: Human...
: I wonder if that word describes me at all.
: I see myself as one who walks among humans, but is something different. An insect, perhaps. And some days, I feel as if I’m nothing at all.
: But that is okay, for I have emptied out every ounce of myself to make room for His message that will one day save us all.
: Or at least those of us who are smart enough to believe.
: I...think you’re a human, Yasu...
: Unless...you’re actually a...shapeshifter or...something like that...
: Touka told me the same thing.
: I have been worrying her quite a bit lately. And I hate myself for becoming such a nuisance, but I keep making silly mistakes that even He does not look favorably upon.
: If I am the same as the rest of you, why am I the only one who wants something different?
: Why am I the only one who can not grasp the concept of being a normal girl? Or even understand what “normal” is?
: For me, all that exists is God.
: But maybe that’s because He is all that’s ever existed for me in the first place.
: I hope saying that was not a sin. And if it was, forgive me Father. You may take whatever you please from me in exchange for your holy pardon.
: What do you mean that...God is...the only thing that’s ever existed?...
: Didn’t you...have...family or?...
: I have no mother...nor father. Nor anyone else...
: But I do not need such relationships when they would be nothing but obstacles between the truth and me.

: If I am to assist in ushering in a new age of prosperity, where all who have avoided ruin look up to Him as the one true creator and follow His doctrines as the laws that guide the land, I need no family.
: But even if I did-
: There is not one out there who would want me.
: That’s not true, Yasu...I’m sure that...there’s at least...someone who...
: I am not human. Therefore, there is no family in which I’d possibly fit.
: A more adequate description would be that I’m a monster.
: And that my inclusion anywhere other than where I am meant to be would only serve to destroy those who lived there first.
: Did...your god...tell you that?...
: No.
: Everyone else did.
: For as long as I can remember, I have been more than just myself.
: There are worlds on top of this one that only I can see, but there is no one else who believes in them.
: And while I remain dedicated to finding those who can, I haven’t had very good luck so far.
: But that is my plight. It is part of my test. And I must face this harsh adversity because it will bring me one step closer to salvation after all the pain has come and gone.
: This world is filled with so many good things...so why is it that people turn away in fear when I share them?
: Why should we ignore the other worlds when ours lacks so much of the information we need to understand why we’re here to begin with?
: And why do we simply accept that the things taken away from us are gone forever when they’re always right behind us?
: The...
: The first time...and you might not remember it...but the first time we...talked, you...
: You mentioned...something about...someone else...that...that was...um...
: He’s here now too.
: Wh...who is it, though?! Who...do you see?!
: I’m sorry if I didn’t explain things well as I’m not very smart, but when I say that I can see things, it is mostly a figure of speech.
: It is more like knowing.
: I can sense the existence of what was once here and compare it with what is still on other planes, but it is not as if I can reach out and touch any of it.
: E...Either way...do you...have any idea...who it is?...Can you talk to them?...
: Would it hurt you if I said I could?
: No! I...I want you to...be able to...
: Would you call me a monster if I reached out on your behalf...and the person you miss the most had me deliver a message you didn’t want to hear?
: No! I...I wouldn’t even think of that! There’s just...
: I lost someone...really important to me...a few years ago and...I still...haven’t really...
: Why not talk to him yourself?
: I...I don’t know how...
: I could show you a million times over and you’d still say the same thing.
: It is not that you don’t know how. It is that you are opposed to learning.
: And so you will remain in blissful ignorance...because you and the one who came before you could not find it in yourselves to believe.
: Yasu...I...don’t really understand what...
: He watches you when you do it.
: Do...what? What...is he watching me do?...
: Indulge.
: It can be lonely on the other side.
: He enjoys the entertainment.
: You’re a dirty...dirty girl.
: I’m...what?
: You’re so lucky...being free enough to pleasure yourself without understanding the consequences.
: And so frequently as well. You’re going to go blind.
: It is what you wanted when I arrived.
: It is what lured me here.
: I can trace the scent of pheromones from worlds away, and you are so pathetically pungent that it makes me want to puke.
: You want it right now...don’t you?
: You want someone to pull you into the forest and POP your fucking cherry before tossing you to the side and leaving you to rot.
: What would you say if I told you I’ve found the perfect person for that job?
: And that the one you miss the most would be happy to watch that as well?...
: Yasu! Where are- oh! Found you!
: Masturbation is a sin, you horny bitch.
: If you want to win that stupid contest, all you have to do is spread your legs.
: We all know you want to anyway.
: Yasu! Where have you been? I’ve been looking all over for you!
: I’m sorry for disappearing, Touka! I must have gotten lost again.
: I told you to stay close to me at all times. I don’t want you wandering off and getting hurt.
: I’m sorry, Touka. It won’t happen again.

: Well, it has to happen at least one more time as your Dorm Wars contest is centered around that exact thing. But this time, it will be expected and I’ll be with you for at least half of the journey.
: Hooray! Competition!
: Yes. Hooray. Now, please follow me and-
: Wha- Yasu?! What part of “stay near me” do you not understand?! Cease this sudden defiance at once!
: I found a shell! Look, Touka!
: Ugh. That girl. I swear I-
: Sana?...What’s wrong?
: Did something happen?
: If Yasu said something strange to you, I’d like to apologize on her behalf. I’m sure you may have noticed by now, but she is not exactly-
: Keep...her...away...from me...
: What?...
: Wait! Sana! Please understand! My family’s medical staff is working around the clock to ensure that Yasu is properly-
: Touka, look! Another shell!
: Aaaaaaaah! Why won’t anyone let me talk?!
